The metal that reinforces much of the weapon adds some additional weight but offers heightened durability.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 36 |durability = 50 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Steel Lizal Bow}} Steel Lizal Bows are [[Bow]]s mostly found in the [[Hebra Mountains]] and [[Akkala Highlands]], where they are used by [[Black Lizalfos]], [[Silver Lizalfos]], and [[Golden Lizalfos]]. Elemental [[Lizalfos]] such as [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]] also use them. The Lizalfos that wield them are known to be expert marksmen. While the metal reinforcements of Steel Lizal Bows increase their durability, they also end up adding weight. They belong to the [[Lizalfos Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s created and utilized by Lizalfos.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Due to their metallic components, Steel Lizal Bows will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, Steel Lizal Bows will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_030" |Life = 50 |Power = 36 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 10 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 25 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 5 |LeadShotAng = 20.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 3 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Steel Lizal Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Steel Lizal Bows reappear in {{AoC}}, being wielding by the strongest variety of [[Lizalfos]].
